reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: Section 11 selects Arizona law (outside the accepted New York/Delaware/California/England and Wales set) and Section 19 mandates binding arbitration instead of a court forum.

p0043 edit is minimal and directionally correct — only the jurisdiction words are swapped ('laws of the Arizona' → 'laws of the State of New York'), leaving severability and conflict-of-laws language intact.

p0056 rewrite reaches the preferred position (exclusive jurisdiction of state and federal courts in New York County with consent to personal jurisdiction/venue waiver); the high changed-character ratio is justified because removing mandatory arbitration necessarily replaces the arbitration mandate and the now-inapplicable award-confirmation sentence, and the replacement grammatically continues the 'Disputes' sentence.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, explains the change, cites the playbook position, and offers the Delaware/California fallback.
